name: Kikkoman Less Sodium Soy Sauce (Naturally Brewed)
whyItWorks: Naturally brewed and aged, which breaks down soybean proteins into savory free glutamates. The 37% lower sodium level protects against dehydration and fluid retention, providing clean savory flavor over plain white rice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 teaspoons over hot steamed Jasmine or Basmati white rice and poached eggs.
watchOuts: Contains wheat and soy; choose Tamari if following a gluten-free diet.
